title: Midnight Craving Steamed Rice Bowl
description: A simple and comforting bowl filled with steamed rice, eggs, and a hint of nutty crunch.
instructions: Rinse the rice and cook according to package instructions.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add the eggs.
Scramble the eggs until they are cooked through.
Add the chopped nuts to the pan and stir to combine.
Spoon the cooked rice into a bowl and top with the eggs and nuts.
